contracts.queueRefund: queueRefund(t,{provider,providerRef,providerTransactionId,userId,amountKobo,kind,reason,metadata,simulated}) -> {duplicate,refund}. Uses caller DB TX; provider POST absent. Required positive exact amount; one excess per charge bound to owner/amount/transaction; advisory lock safely adopts historical amount-keyed excess claims.
contracts.dispatchRefund: dispatchRefund(refundId,{actorUserId,actorRole,ip}={}) -> {ok,duplicate,refund,providerResult?}. Atomically queued -> claimed before one provider POST. Claimed/submitted/review_required never automatically POST again.
contracts.completeTopUp: verifiedAmountKobo and simulated options; all owner callers must pass fresh provider verified amount. Transaction:t defers dispatch to refund reconciler; external standalone settlement dispatches only after commit.
contracts.lookupRefund: known refund ID required. Every returned refund must match refund ID, original charge ID, exact NGN amount/currency, reference if supplied. Uncorrelated evidence is reviewRequired.
contracts.Flutterwave: POST /v3/transactions/{transactionID}/refund exact whole naira amount >= NGN100; GET /v3/refunds/{refundID}. completed = pending. Final = completed-bank-transfer/completed-momo/completed-mpgs/completed-offline/completed-preauth.
contracts.Paystack: GET /refund/{refundID}; exact integer minor-unit amount; transaction original ID or embedded object; processed = final. Parent implementation POST /refund exact partial amount retained.

impact.persistence: Existing payment_refunds only; metadata refundDispatch states queued/claimed/submitted/review_required; no migrations or new dependency
impact.publicContract: Provider acceptance leaves pending until correlated final disbursement; overpaid valid purchases activate their original quote and record exact excess
impact.concurrency: DB transaction purchase+intent and advisory/refund row claim enforce crossworker uniqueness; process locks absent
impact.recovery: Killed worker after queue commit is dispatchable; killed worker after claim/provider acceptance is pending review and never resend
impact.reversibility: Code reversible; preserve live refund metadata/claims on rollback; do not revert to blind POST or completed=settled behavior
